affiliation.zh: 计算机与信息学院（人工智能学院） · 合肥工业大学
affiliation.en: School of Computer Science and Information Engineering · Hefei University of Technology

intro.zh: 我就读于合肥工业大学计算机与信息学院（人工智能学院）。我的研究兴趣包括无线感知、人机交互、普适计算与智能健康感知。目前的工作关注基于 WiFi 信号的跨域手势识别、无接触呼吸功能检测及感知系统的实际部署。
intro.en: I am a student at the School of Computer Science and Information Engineering, Hefei University of Technology. My research interests include wireless sensing, human-computer interaction, ubiquitous computing, and intelligent health sensing. My current work focuses on cross-domain WiFi gesture recognition, contact-free pulmonary function assessment, and practical sensing systems.

openings.zh: 欢迎对无线感知、人机交互与智能健康感兴趣的同学交流合作。
openings.en: I welcome discussions and collaborations on wireless sensing, human-computer interaction, and intelligent health.

text.zh: 关于大模型感知的跨域 WiFi 手势识别论文发表于 IEEE ICPADS 2025。
text.en: Our work on large-model-aware cross-domain WiFi gesture recognition was published at IEEE ICPADS 2025.

text.zh: 作为团队成员获中国国际大学生创新大赛（2024）产业命题赛道国家级金奖。
text.en: Received a National Gold Award as a team member in the Industry Track of the China International College Students' Innovation Competition (2024).

text.zh: Wi-Pulmo 无接触肺功能感知研究发表于 IEEE Internet of Things Journal。
text.en: Our contact-free pulmonary function sensing work, Wi-Pulmo, was published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal.
